family: F3i fast maker: improve by one tick when our side's queue is heavy
event: a book row where the UP best bid rises or the UP best ask falls (new best level, >= 5 shares), window has >= 20 s left
decision: at row time + book delay: spread >= 2 ticks and the new level still best; own-side imbalance > 0.6, where I=(UP bid size - UP ask size)/(sum) at the book seen, own = I for a bid on UP, -I for an offer on UP (= bid on DOWN)
order: post-only BUY 5 shares one tick inside the spread on that side (UP bid + 1 tick, or DOWN bid + 1 tick = UP ask - 1 tick); one live order per side
pull: cancel (lands +cancel ms) at the first of: someone improves past our price (out); the opposite best moves toward us (opp); TTL 5 s
fill_model: dsim maker, pess (alone at a new price, so pess ~ prop ~ front)
caveats: our order is absent from the recorded book: penny-jumping reactions of other bots to it are not modelled
the dep rule is inert in improve mode (no queue ahead)
settlement P&L is noisy; the 1 s markout is the robust part
